details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: race condition in ssl.SSLContext.cert_store_stats()
     and get_ca_certs()
     - debian/patches/CVE-2024-0397.patch: in Modules/_ssl.c, take a locked
       copy of the X509_STORE object list (shim of OpenSSL 3.3's
       X509_STORE_get1_objects()) instead of iterating the live list, so a
       concurrent certificate load can no longer free entries while they are
       read. Backport of upstream commit 29c97287d205 (gh-114572, 3.8
       branch); the get_ca_certs() failure path releases the result list,
       as in the original 3.12 fix.
     - CVE-2024-0397
   * SECURITY UPDATE: incorrect "private"/"global" classification of IP
     address ranges
     - debian/patches/CVE-2024-4032.patch: in Lib/ipaddress.py, update the
       is_private / is_global tables to the IANA special-purpose registries
       and handle IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses. Backport of upstream commit
       895f7e2ac23e (gh-113171, 3.8 branch); the Doc/whatsnew/3.8.rst hunk
       is dropped. Bundles the upstream regression tests.
     - CVE-2024-4032
   * SECURITY UPDATE: infinite loop or deadlock in tarfile on archives with
     a negative member offset
     - debian/patches/CVE-2025-8194.patch: in Lib/tarfile.py, reject negative
       sizes in TarInfo._block() with InvalidHeaderError. Backport of
       upstream commit 73f03e4808 (gh-130577, 3.9 branch). Bundles the
       upstream regression tests, placed by hand in test_tarfile.py.
     - CVE-2025-8194
   * SECURITY UPDATE: use-after-free in a reused bz2/lzma decompressor
     after MemoryError
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-6100.patch: in Modules/_bz2module.c and
       Modules/_lzmamodule.c, clear next_in on the decompress() error path
       so a later call no longer reads the caller's released buffer.
       Backport of upstream commit 47128e64f98c (gh-148395, 3.10 branch).
     - CVE-2026-6100
   * SECURITY UPDATE: IMAP command injection via CR/LF in command
     arguments
     - debian/patches/CVE-2025-15366.patch: in Lib/imaplib.py, reject NUL,
       CR and LF in IMAP4._command() arguments with ValueError, so a
       caller-supplied argument can no longer smuggle extra IMAP commands.
       Other control characters are still accepted, following the upstream
       narrowing of the check. Backport of upstream commit 71926d943c05
       (gh-143921, GH-143922 + GH-153067, 3.13 branch). Bundles a
       regression test adapted to the 3.7 test server.
     - CVE-2025-15366
   * SECURITY UPDATE: POP3 command injection via control characters in
     command arguments
     - debian/patches/CVE-2025-15367.patch: in Lib/poplib.py, reject C0
       control characters and DEL in POP3._putcmd() with ValueError.
       Backport of upstream commit b234a2b67539 (gh-143923). Bundles the
       upstream regression test.
     - CVE-2025-15367
   * SECURITY UPDATE: webbrowser dash-prefix check bypass via "%action"
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-4786.patch: in Lib/webbrowser.py, run the
       CVE-2026-4519 leading-dash check in UnixBrowser.open() on the URL
       after "%action" is expanded, and substitute "%action" before "%s",
       so a URL can no longer inject browser options through "%action".
       Backport of upstream commit d22922c8a795 (gh-148169), taken from
       the amazonlinux2els 3.7.16 donor. Bundles the upstream regression
       test.
     - CVE-2026-4786
   * SECURITY UPDATE: email header injection via newlines in generated
     headers (prerequisite of CVE-2026-1299)
     - debian/patches/CVE-2024-6923.patch: in Lib/email, encode atoms that
       contain CR or LF when refolding, and add the verify_generated_headers
       policy attribute (default True) and email.errors.HeaderWriteError, so
       Generator refuses to write a header that is improperly folded or
       delimited. Backport of upstream commit f7be505d137a (gh-121650, 3.9
       branch), taken from the amazonlinux2els 3.7.16 donor and adapted to
       3.7.3. Bundles the upstream regression tests.
     - CVE-2024-6923
   * SECURITY UPDATE: email header injection through BytesGenerator
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-1299.patch: in Lib/email/generator.py, apply
       the verify_generated_headers checks in BytesGenerator._write_headers()
       too. Backport of upstream commit 052e55e7d447 (gh-144125), taken from
       the amazonlinux2els 3.7.16 donor. Bundles the upstream regression
       tests.
     - CVE-2026-1299
   * Fix email header folding regressions exposed by the header checks
     above
     - debian/patches/bpo-34424.patch: in Lib/email/_header_value_parser.py,
       strip the whole policy.linesep instead of one character when
       refolding an encoded word, so smtplib.send_message() no longer raises
       HeaderWriteError on encoded-word headers. Backport of upstream commit
       c0abd0c8e9b6 (bpo-34424, 3.7.4), applied before CVE-2024-6923.patch.
     - debian/patches/gh-142006.patch: drop an empty line left in the fold
       buffer when trailing whitespace is moved to the next line. Backport of
       upstream commit 90ca216cdcb7 (gh-142006, 3.13 branch).
